summary: Iteration 17 – Piatti componibili (composable dishes). Backend: new pytest suite test_composable_dishes.py (18/18 PASS) covering option-groups CRUD (server ids, duplicate names 400, max<min 400, invalid id 404, delete unused -> archived/hidden, 2nd delete 404, delete in use 409 with dish name), dishes (composable w/o groups 400, basePrice 0 ok, non composable saves optionGroupIds=[], PUT toggle on/off), daily-menu unavailableOptionIds (deduplicated), orders (missing base 'Scegli', two bases 'massimo 1', double base w/o allowRepeat, esaurito, garbage id, empty selections, selections on non composable -> 400; unitPrice 14.0 = 0+5.5+3*2+2.5, subtotal, composition snapshot fields, portions -2, customPrice override), PATCH by-index recompute (8.5, subtotal/total updated; already-chosen option kept even after marked esaurito; new add with esaurito rejected; selections on non composable item 400), kitchen + porzionatura entries include composition, custom item regression, cross-tenant (tenant B cannot list/update/delete A's group -> 404, cannot link it -> 400 'Gruppo di scelta non trovato'). Public payload verified by calling _build_public_payload in-process for Napoli (read-only, in-memory published copy): price 5.5 'da', priceFrom true, optionGroups without esaurito Salmone, notes 'TEST_Base: Insalata mista, Cous cous, Patate e carote +0,50 € · TEST_Proteine: Pollo +3,00 €, Uova +2,50 €'. Frontend (desktop 1920 + iPad 768): Piatti -> Gruppi modal, new group editor (multi mode, 2 options, duplicate name -> inline notice 'Due ingredienti hanno lo stesso nome', allergen chips, repeat toggle, save -> 'Gruppo salvato'), dish modal composable toggle + numbered group chips, price 0 saved, card badge + 'da 5,50 €', delete group in use (2 taps) -> notice 'Gruppo usato da: TEST_UI_Panino...'. Menu: composable dish added with price 0, row 'Componibile · TEST_Base + TEST_UI_Salse' + 'da 5,50 €', edit -> 'Ingredienti di oggi' chips toggle esaurito, save persists ('1 esauriti oggi'); normal dish with price 0 rejected ('Inserisci un prezzo valido'). Ordini: composer in footer, confirm disabled + 'Scegli TEST_Base' until base chosen, Salmone shown 'Esaurito' and plus does nothing, live price 0 -> 5.50 -> 14.00 -> 11.50, add -> row composition green 'Cous cous + Pollo ×2', list card summary ': Patate e carote + Uova', edit pencil prefilled composer, change base + add Uova -> 14.00, total 31.00. Report: Cucina & Porzionatura show composition lines. Normal dish still adds to order at daily price. Found 1 medium backend edge bug and a swapped testID (fixed).

minor.issue: 409 guard only checks dishes with active:true. Repro (tests/manual_composable_edge.py): composable dish with one required group in today's menu -> deactivate dish -> delete group (200, archived) -> reactivate dish via PUT {active:true} (no re-validation, isComposable stays true with an archived group id) -> POST order item without selections returns 200 with unitPrice 0.0 and empty composition. Even without reactivation the dish is still in today's menu and add_order_item does not check dish.active. Fix: in delete_group check all dishes (not only active) OR in add_order_item/update when isComposable and load_groups() returns fewer groups than optionGroupIds -> 400 'Piatto componibile senza gruppi'; also run _check_composable when reactivating.

Public item 'allergens' only contains dish-level allergens; allergens declared on options (e.g. Uova -> uova) are only inside optionGroups[].options[].allergens. A website/widget that only renders item.allergens will not show them. Consider merging option allergens (or at least documenting optionGroups for the site).

ui_bugs.issue: testIDs were swapped: Porzionatura section used kitchen-entry-composition-* and Cucina section used porz-entry-composition-*. FIXED by testing agent (lines 824/958).

issues: Mixed decimal formats: composer/groups use '5,50 €' but order rows use '2 x 8.50 €', footer '11.50 €', menu 'Piatti Disponibili' shows 'Prezzo base: 0.00 €' for a composable dish (could show 'da 5,50 €'), group editor reopens price as '0.5' while new rows show '0,50'.

Footer price shows '0.00 €' before a base is chosen; showing 'da 5,50 €' would be clearer. Composer takes ~60% of the viewport on desktop but is usable/scrollable; on iPad 768x1024 confirm button and all rows reachable.

'Esaurito oggi' is per menu item: a shared group ingredient (e.g. a base used by Piatto Fit and Panino) must be marked esaurito on each dish separately. Probably fine but worth a hint text or a 'apply to all dishes' option.
Known pre-existing: error toast ('Inserisci un prezzo valido') renders behind the RN modal overlay.

action_items: Guard against composable dishes whose groups were archived (delete_group should consider inactive dishes too, and add_order_item should reject composable dish with missing groups / inactive dish) – see repro
Optionally expose option allergens at item level in the public payload
Unify price formatting (comma decimal) in order rows/footer/menu available list
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx is 4787 lines, menu.tsx 2009, reports.tsx 2168 – far above 700-line guideline; composable logic was well extracted into src/components/composable + utils/composition.ts, keep doing that.
update_dish: reactivation (active:true) does not re-run _check_composable, so stale/archived optionGroupIds survive.
add_order_item loads the dish without checking dish.active; menu items of deactivated dishes stay orderable (pre-existing behaviour, but combined with group archive yields 0 € sale).

update_order_item_by_index: unitPrice = old unitPrice - old extra + new extra keeps manual price tweaks – correct, but if the group option prices changed since the order, old extra is taken from snapshot (good).
public_options floor = min(price)*minSelect assumes repeats allowed for minSelect>1 without allowRepeat; minor approximation for 'da' price.
DailyMenuAddItem/MenuItemUpdate dailyPrice has no server-side ge=0 validation (price>0 for normal dishes only enforced in UI).
